verdict.rationale: Branching is a fair axis for a managed database, but the evidence shows no database-branching feature, per-PR branches, or CI/deploy-platform integration for automatic create and teardown. The clickhousectl CLI can create cloud clusters and manage resources, but provisioning whole services is an adjacent capability, not branching, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can create and tear down per-pull-request database branches automatically from CI or my deploy platform
